title: Lesson plans (KTP)
intro: Upload your KTP once. Bilig then shows what you teach each day and builds the lesson plan for any lesson.

steps.label: How it works
steps.two: We check the dates and hours
steps.three: Get any lesson plan in one click

upload.title: Add a KTP
upload.replaceNote: The lessons in the new file will replace the current ones. Changes you made here will not be kept.
upload.checkingHint: Reading the lessons, dates and hours. This takes a few seconds.
upload.notDocx: This is not a .docx file. In Word, save the KTP as “Word Document (.docx)” and try again.
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB.
upload.failed: We could not read this file

summary.title: Your KTP is ready
summary.allGood: No problems found. You are all set.
summary.later: You can fix them now or later. Lesson plans can be downloaded in the meantime.

list.title: My KTPs
list.empty: You have no KTP yet. Add one and your lessons will show up here, day by day.
list.confirmDelete: Delete “{{title}}”? Lesson plans you have already downloaded stay on your computer.

issue.no_lessons: We found no lesson table in the file.
issue.date_missing: There is no date for class {{class}}.
issue.date_invalid: The KTP says “{{date}}”, but that date does not exist.
issue.date_same_day: A second lesson on the same day ({{date}}).
issue.hours_mismatch: The KTP header says {{declared}} hours, but the lessons add up to {{actual}}.
issue.section_hours_mismatch: The section “{{section}}” says {{declared}} hours, but its lessons take {{actual}}.

fix.no_lessons: Check that the file has a table with lesson topics and dates.
fix.title_missing: Write the topic of the lesson.
fix.date_missing: Add the day you teach this lesson.
fix.date_order: Check the date. Lessons should go in order.
fix.date_sunday: Move the lesson to a school day.
fix.date_holiday: Move the lesson to a school day.
fix.date_out_of_year: Check the year of the date.
fix.hours_mismatch: This is only a note about the file. Your lesson plans are not affected.
fix.section_hours_mismatch: Look over the lessons of this section.

plan.notFound: This KTP was not found. It may have been deleted.
plan.noRows: We found no lessons in this file. Check that the KTP has a table with lesson topics and dates.

week.downloadLabel_one: Download the plan for this week's {{count}} lesson (.docx)
week.downloadLabel_other: Download the plans for this week's {{count}} lessons (.docx)
week.emptyHint: It may be a school break.

action.planFor: Download the plan of lesson {{n}} for {{class}} (.docx)

all.sectionHours: the KTP says {{declared}} h, the lessons take {{actual}} h

sheet.dateFormat: Write the date as dd.mm.yyyy, for example 20.10.2026.
sheet.pickDate: Choose the date for {{class}} in a calendar

settings.title: KTP file and settings
settings.hours: The lessons add up to {{actual}} hours (the KTP header says {{declared}})

draftNote: Each plan is a draft. Check it before the lesson and choose the competency codes.
conflict: This KTP was changed somewhere else. We loaded the latest version. Check your change and make it again.
downloadError: Could not build the plan. Please try again.
